article_manifest.title: GAO: 234 trainees complete their Inter-Arms Certificate (CIA) training
article_manifest.original_title: GAO : 234 stagiaires achèvent leur formation au Certificat Interarmes (CIA)
article_manifest.summary: The Gao Mixed Instruction Center hosted, on Wednesday, October 7, 2026, the ceremony of end of training of the first wave of the Joint Certificate (CIA), session 2025, started on July 10, 2026. For three months, 234 trainees from the Defence and Security Forces underwent training to strengthen their military knowledge and skills . At the end of this course, they are now able to assume the functions of deputy non-commissioned officer to the section head.

article_manifest.title: DIRECTORATE OF THE ARMED FORCES COMMISSARIAT: The Chief of the General Staff of the Armed Forces on an official visit
article_manifest.original_title: DIRECTION DU COMMISSARIAT DES ARMÉES : Le Chef d’État-Major Général des Armées en visite d’autorité
article_manifest.summary: The Chief of the General Staff of the Armed Forces (CEMGA), Major General Elisée Jean DAO, visited the Directorate of the Commissariat of the Armed Forces (DCA), formerly Military Headquarters, on Friday, October 9, 2026. This visit is a continuation of the authority visits made by the CMSA to the various service directorates of the Malian Armed Forces since his appointment as head of the institution in May .

article_manifest.title: Court remands Nigerien man in Abuja for alleged supply of AK-47 ammunition for terrorism
article_manifest.original_title: Court remands Nigerien man in Abuja for alleged supply of AK-47 ammunition for terrorism
article_manifest.summary: The Federal High Court in Abuja on Friday remanded a Nigerien national, Muhammad Ibrahim, over charges of transporting 170 rounds of AK-47 ammunition for terrorist activities in Katsina State. Judge Salim Ibrahim ordered that Mr Ibrahim be remanded at the Kuje Correctional Centre in Abuja after he pleaded not guilty to four counts, including terrorism and fraudulent acquisition of a Nigerian identification number – the National Identity Number (NIN).

article_manifest.title: Nobel Peace Prize 2026: Africa in the spotlight with South Africa's Navi Pillay
article_manifest.original_title: Nobel de la paix 2026 : l’Afrique à l’honneur avec la Sud-Africaine Navi Pillay
article_manifest.summary: Africa is in the spotlight on the international scene. South Africa's Navi Pillay won the Nobel Peace Prize on Friday, October 9, 2026. This distinction highlights the journey of an African woman committed to defending human rights and respecting international law Former United Nations High Commissioner for Human Rights and former judge at the International Criminal Court (ICC), she has distinguished herself by her fight against impunity and for justice.

article_manifest.title: Mali: In Kidal, soldiers outnumber locals
article_manifest.original_title: Mali: à Kidal, les soldats sont plus nombreux que les habitants
article_manifest.summary: Mali: in Kidal, the soldiers outnumber the inhabitants Three days after their return to Kidal, the Malian soldiers and their Russian partners of the Africa Corps secure the city and its surroundings. The army conducts daily airstrikes in the area but has not yet continued its ground advance The separatists of the Azawad Liberation Front (Fla) and the jihadists of the Support Group for Islam and Muslims (Jnim), linked to al-Qaeda, were forced to withdraw before the arrival of the army in Kidal.

article_manifest.title: Burkina Faso: The export of millet, maize and sorghum flour suspended until further notice
article_manifest.original_title: Burkina Faso : L’exportation des farines de mil, de maïs et de sorgho suspendue jusqu’à nouvel ordre
article_manifest.summary: The Burkinabe government suspends, until further notice, the export of millet, maize and sorghum flour, as well as their derivatives, throughout the national territory. The measure aims to ensure the availability of these products on the internal market and to improve their accessibility to consumers . In a press release dated 9 October 2026, the Ministry of Industry, Trade and Handicrafts informed economic operators and populations of this decision.

article_manifest.title: In Mali, the recapture of the city of Kidal offers a symbolic victory to the junta and its Russian ally
article_manifest.original_title: Au Mali, la reprise de la ville de Kidal offre une victoire symbolique à la junte et à son allié russe
article_manifest.summary: In Mali, the recapture of the city of Kidal offers a symbolic victory to the junta and its DECRYPTING Russian ally - The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by Russian mercenaries and Tuareg loyalists, have taken over this rebel-held city since a general offensive in April. Skip adWinners didn't repeat the mistake . On November 14, 2023, during the first conquest of Kidal by the Malian army with the support of Wagner, the Russian mercenaries, enlisted by the ruling junta, had raised their black flag with a death's head.

article_manifest.title: Resumption of Kidal: place for the security and effective return of state services
article_manifest.original_title: Reprise de Kidal : place à la sécurisation et au retour effectif des services de l’État
article_manifest.summary: The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) consolidated their presence in Kidal on 6 October 2026, at the end of military operations carried out as part of Operation Dougoukoloko, with the support of their Russian partners. This breakthrough is an important step . The sustainable security of the city, the protection of the population and the effective return of state services are now major issues.

article_manifest.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
article_manifest.title: Gao: Trial of nine (9) criminal cases involving 11 defendants
article_manifest.original_title: Gao : jugement de neuf (9) affaires criminelles impliquant 11 accusés
article_manifest.summary: Gao, 9 October (AMAP) The first session of the criminal chamber of the Gao High Court ended on 8 October 2026 in the City of Askias, noted AMAP . Started on October 6, this series of hearings aimed to deal with 9 major criminal cases involving a total of 11 defendants including the nature of the cases examined and all judged at the very first hearing of the criminal chamber of the Gao High Court, namely 2 murders, 3 pedophilia, 2 fatal strokes, 1 rape and 1 murder During these hearings, the Criminal Chamber of the Gao TGI pronounced sanctions commensurate with the criminal offences committed.

article_manifest.title: Fama takeover of Kidal: Choguel Maiga's reaction
article_manifest.original_title: Prise de Kidal par les FAMA : La réaction de Choguel Maiga
article_manifest.summary: Capture of Kidal by the Fama: Choguel Maiga Kidal's reaction is no longer in the hands of the terrorists. This strategic town in northern Mali was recaptured by the Malian Armed Forces (Fama) on October 6, after a vast military offensive carried out with the support of the Russian partners of Africorps. From the prison of Koulikoro, the former Malian Prime Minister Choguel Maiga congratulated the FAMa for their shine .

article_manifest.title: West Africa: Russia-Ukraine Conflict Finds New Battleground in Africa's Sahel
article_manifest.original_title: West Africa: Russia-Ukraine Conflict Finds New Battleground in Africa's Sahel
article_manifest.summary: Ukraine has vowed to counter Russia wherever it can, even "in the scorching sands" of the Sahelian desert, as evidence mounts that Kyiv is backing Tuareg separatists battling Mali's army and its Russian allies. Mali, Niger and Burkina Faso -- all led by military juntas that have turned their backs on former colonial ruler France and moved closer to Russia -- have reacted by severing diplomatic relations with Kyiv.

article_manifest.title: South Africa: the army deployed after xenophobic violence
article_manifest.original_title: Afrique du Sud : l’armée déployée après des violences xénophobes
article_manifest.summary: Police and the army were deployed Friday in Durban and Soweto after anti-immigration protests turned violent, leaving at least 24 vehicles burned and several businesses owned by foreigners targeted. South African authorities have stepped up their security presence in both cities to prevent further violence, in the wake of clashes between South African protesters and foreign nationals.

article_manifest.title: Mali: "The army has its place in Kidal but regaining it does not end the violence", for the opposition coalition CFR
article_manifest.original_title: Mali: «L'armée a sa place à Kidal mais la reconquérir ne met pas fin aux violences», pour la coalition d'opposition CFR
article_manifest.summary: In Mali, the army and its Russian partners in the Africa Corps retook Kidal in the north on 6 October from the Fla separatists and the Jnim jihadists, who had controlled it for more than five months. A victory for the transitional authorities who intend to restore the authority of the State throughout the territory . The CFR, a coalition of opponents in exile, also defends national sovereignty throughout the territory but advocates dialogue with armed groups.

article_manifest.title: Burkina Faso: The junta tries to relax with the Sunnis
article_manifest.original_title: Burkina Faso: La junte tente une décrispation avec les sunnites
article_manifest.summary: The release this Sunday, October 4, 2026, of approximately 80 supporters of Imam Mohamed Kindo is a political signal. Arrested at the end of May after a banned demonstration, shaved, and sent for training at the police camp, they are returning to their families. With video evidence, the junta is carefully staging a display of appeasement.

article_manifest.title: "Epic of Niger", a project by cultural entrepreneur Ibrahima Abdoul-Rachid: "It is enough for a people to turn to their memory for the future to change"
article_manifest.original_title: « Épopée du Niger », un projet de l’entrepreneur culturel Ibrahima Abdoul-Rachid : « Il suffit qu’un peuple se tourne vers sa mémoire pour que l’avenir change »
article_manifest.summary: Through the ecological company A.S.I.D., founded in 2020 and continuously active, Mr. Soumaila Ibrahima Abdoul-Rachid, cultural entrepreneur, proposes innovative and multisectoral initiatives combining ecology, digital and culture . This includes waste recovery such as the transformation of used tyres into urban and school furniture, edutainment projects, as well as the production of major cultural and transmedia works that strengthen the memory and intellectual sovereignty of the Nigerien public.

article_manifest.title: Talhandak, Kidal and Tessalit: Terrorist Positions Targeted and Accurately Addressed
article_manifest.original_title: Talhandak, Kidal et Tessalit : Des positions terroristes ciblées et traitées avec précision ACTUALITES
article_manifest.summary: The announcement was made on October 7, 2026 by the General Staff of the Armed Forces which indicates that in the continuity of the offensive launched in the East Theater, the air-land operations conducted today made it possible to precisely target several positions of the armed terrorist groups . On the ground, according to the security source, the responsiveness of the units made it possible to obtain convincing results, in particular in Talhandak, where terrorist elements who had sheltered under a canopy were neutralized and their vehicle completely destroyed .

A victory for the transitional authorities who intend to restore the authority of the State throughout the territory .

article_manifest.title: Operation Dougoukoloko: FAMa precision strikes against terrorist bases in San, Takalot and Talhandak
article_manifest.original_title: Opération Dougoukoloko : Frappes de précision des FAMa contre des bases terroristes à San, Takalot et Talhandak
article_manifest.summary: The General Staff of the Armed Forces informs the national opinion that the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners, are continuing the permanent operations of surveillance, control and security of the national territory as part of Operation Dougoukoloko In the continuation of the offensive launched in the Eastern Theater, the air-land operations conducted on Thursday, October 8, 2026 made it possible to target several positions of the armed terrorist groups.

article_manifest.title: Niger: Niger's Junta Tightens Its Grip On Free Expression
article_manifest.original_title: Niger: Niger's Junta Tightens Its Grip On Free Expression
article_manifest.summary: Lawyer Tried on Bogus Charges; Journalist Feared Forcibly Disappeared A lawyer in Niger faces prosecution over comments about the army on social media while a prominent journalist and critic of the country's military junta is being held in secret, with authorities refusing to identify his alleged offense. These cases together highlight a broadening crackdown in Niger, where the space for free expression is shrinking by the day.

article_manifest.title: Saddam Haftar: from the Sahel to Chad, the limits of security diplomacy
article_manifest.original_title: Saddam Haftar : du Sahel au Tchad, les limites d’une diplomatie sécuritaire
article_manifest.summary: Saddam Haftar: from the Sahel to Chad, the limits of a security diplomacy Between the release of hostages, support for rebel movements and a new alliance with Chad, Marshal Haftar's heir seeks to establish himself as an essential interlocutor. And dreams as a future president of a reunified Libya that would weigh again on continental diplomacy. Published today at 07:00, modified at 10:11 Reading: 10 minutes .

article_manifest.title: No to family war!
article_manifest.original_title: Non à la guerre familiale !
article_manifest.summary: We have VDPs on the battlefield against the forces of evil, but who are the VDPs in our families and where are they? We have been at war against terrorism for a decade but in our families, we shoot each other with live ammunition and at close range, among blood brothers, sometimes in deafening silence, sometimes with an unprecedented noise that attracts crowds .

article_manifest.original_title: ‎ Burkina Faso : L’exportation de la farine de mil, de maïs et de sorgho suspendue jusqu’à nouvel ordre
article_manifest.summary: Burkina Faso: The export of millet, maize and sorghum flour suspended until further notice The export of cereal flour, including millet, maize and sorghum, as well as their derivatives, is suspended throughout the national territory until further notice. The information comes from a press release from the Minister of Trade, Industry and Handicrafts dated October 9, 2026 .

article_manifest.title: Month of Solidarity: President Assimi GOÏTA with the Dean of Bamako The inhabitants of the Troukabougou sector of Djicoroni Para, in Commune IV of the District of Bamako, woke up this Thursday, October 8, 2026 under an impressive security device.
article_manifest.original_title: Mois de la solidarité : Le Président Assimi GOÏTA chez le doyen de Bamako Les habitants du secteur Troukabougou de Djicoroni Para, en Commune IV du District de Bamako, se sont réveillés, ce jeudi 8 octobre 2026 sous un impressionnant dispositif de sécurité.
article_manifest.summary: Very early in the morning, the staking of the elements of the Security Forces announced that this district would welcome a distinguished host, including the President of the Transition, Army General Assimi Goïta, who sacrificed to a well-established tradition of the Month of Solidarity and the Fight against Exclusion, that is to say the visit of the highest authorities to the elderly It was in this spirit that the Head of State went to the bedside of the Dean of Bamako, Namory Keita.

article_manifest.title: In Mali, why the takeover of Kidal is a bitter-tasting victory for the junta
article_manifest.original_title: Au Mali, pourquoi la reprise de Kidal est une victoire au goût amer pour la junte
article_manifest.summary: It had been several days since a scent of reconquest floated in the air. On the morning of Tuesday, October 6, the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by Russian elements of Africa Corps, retook the city of Kidal In a statement dated the same day, the Malian military authorities announced that they had engaged in "large-scale air-land operations in the Kidal region" with a view to "neutralizing armed terrorist groups" and "destroying their sanctuaries".

article_manifest.title: Terrorists’ Illicit Funding Streams Converge
article_manifest.original_title: Terrorists’ Illicit Funding Streams Converge
article_manifest.summary: Jama’at Nusrat al-Islam wal-Muslimin (JNIM) amasses an estimated $100 million a year through a web of illicit activities that illustrates the way terrorism, organized crime and public corruption are connected. “Make no mistake, today illicit economies in the Sahel and West Africa are interlinked criminalities across borders,” David M. Luna, executive director of the International Coalition Against Illicit Economies (ICAIE), told a recent webinar hosted by the Nigerian Financial Intelligence Unit (NFIU).
